```{r setup, include=FALSE}

#Use Personal Dartmouth API Key

if (api_key == "") {
  if (!interactive()) stop("No API key. Set DARTMOUTH_API_KEY in .Renviron before knitting.")
  api_key <- rstudioapi::askForPassword("Dartmouth Chat API key")
```

```{r load-data}
#Loading the Data

tarot_base_data <- read.csv("DataWrangling_SimulationData - Raw Data.csv",
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sim_file <- "DataWrangling_SimulationData - SimulatedData_Final.csv"
```

```{r api-helper}
#An API Hellper to promp chat.dartmouth

ask_dartmouth <- function(user_prompt, system_prompt = NULL,
                          temperature = 0.3, max_tokens = NULL) {
  msgs <- list()
  if (!is.null(system_prompt)) {
    msgs <- c(msgs, list(list(role = "system", content = system_prompt)))
  }
  msgs <- c(msgs, list(list(role = "user", content = user_prompt)))

  body <- list(model = "google.gemma-4-31B-it",
               messages = msgs,
               temperature = temperature)
  if (!is.null(max_tokens)) body$max_tokens <- max_tokens

  res <- POST(paste0(base_url, "/chat/completions"),
              add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key)),
              body = body,
              encode = "json",
              timeout(120))

  if (status_code(res) != 200) {
    stop("API request failed with status ", status_code(res), ": ",
         content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  }

  parsed <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"),
                     simplifyVector = FALSE)
  choice <- parsed$choices[[1]]
  msg    <- choice$message
  out    <- msg$content
  if (is.null(out) || !nzchar(trimws(out))) out <- msg$reasoning_content
  if (is.null(out) || !nzchar(trimws(out))) {
    stop("Empty reply. finish_reason = ", choice$finish_reason)
  }
  out
}
```

```{r}
#Training the Model on the simulated data 

#Preparing the simulated dataframe 
raw_lines <- readLines(sim_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
raw_lines <- str_trim(raw_lines[-1])  
raw_lines <- raw_lines[nzchar(raw_lines)]
cat("Rows found:", length(raw_lines), "\n")

clean_field <- function(x) str_trim(str_replace_all(x, '^"|"$', ""))

parse_row <- function(line) {
  f <- clean_field(str_split(line, ",")[[1]])
  n <- length(f)
  if (n < 13) return(NULL)                   
  tibble(
    card_number_1    = as.integer(f[1]),
    reversed_1       = as.integer(f[2]),
    card_number_2    = as.integer(f[3]),
    reversed_2       = as.integer(f[4]),
    card_number_3    = as.integer(f[5]),
    reversed_3       = as.integer(f[6]),
    card_name_1      = f[7],
    card_name_2      = f[8],
    card_name_3      = f[9],
    reading          = paste(f[10:(n - 3)], collapse = ","),
    top_sentiment    = f[n - 2],
    second_sentiment = f[n - 1],
    third_sentiment  = f[n]
  )
}

tarot_all <- map_dfr(raw_lines, parse_row)

fix_sentiment <- function(x) {
  x <- str_to_title(str_trim(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "Na", "Nan")] <- NA_character_
  case_when(
    x == "Negitive" ~ "Negative",
    x == "Suprise"  ~ "Surprise",
    TRUE            ~ x
  )
}

tarot_all <- tarot_all %>%
  mutate(
    top_sentiment    = fix_sentiment(top_sentiment),
    second_sentiment = fix_sentiment(second_sentiment),
    third_sentiment  = fix_sentiment(third_sentiment)
  )

#Filtering out readings with an "unusable top sentiment" 
bad <- is.na(tarot_all$top_sentiment) | !nzchar(tarot_all$reading)
if (any(bad)) cat("Skipping", sum(bad), "incomplete reading(s).\n")
tarot_train <- tarot_all[!bad, ]
cat("Usable training readings:", nrow(tarot_train), "\n")
stopifnot(nrow(tarot_train) > 0)

label_set <- sort(unique(na.omit(c(tarot_train$top_sentiment,
                                   tarot_train$second_sentiment,
                                   tarot_train$third_sentiment))))

#Generating a training example for the AI model
training_examples <- tarot_train %>%
  mutate(
    o1 = if_else(reversed_1 == 1, "reversed", "upright"),
    o2 = if_else(reversed_2 == 1, "reversed", "upright"),
    o3 = if_else(reversed_3 == 1, "reversed", "upright"),
    line = sprintf(
      "Cards: %s (%s), %s (%s), %s (%s)\nReading: %s\nSentiments (ranked): %s > %s > %s",
      card_name_1, o1, card_name_2, o2, card_name_3, o3,
      reading, top_sentiment, second_sentiment, third_sentiment
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(line) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n\n")

#Sentiment counts associated with each card 
card_evidence <- function(nm) {
  hits <- tarot_train %>%
    filter(str_to_lower(card_name_1) == str_to_lower(nm) |
           str_to_lower(card_name_2) == str_to_lower(nm) |
           str_to_lower(card_name_3) == str_to_lower(nm))
  if (nrow(hits) == 0) return("no simulated readings include this card")
  tally <- count(hits, top_sentiment, sort = TRUE)
  paste0(nrow(hits), " reading(s). Top sentiments: ",
         paste0(tally$top_sentiment, " (", tally$n, ")", collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r draw-and-reading, results = "asis"}
#Card Draw and Reading- needs to be rerun for each reading 

#Here We are selecting the Cards and their Orientations
card_numbers    <- sample(0:77, 3, replace = FALSE)
reverse_upright <- sample(0:1, 3, replace = TRUE)

draw <- tibble(
  position    = c("Past", "Present", "Future"),
  card_number = card_numbers,
  reversed    = reverse_upright
) %>%
  left_join(tarot_base_data, by = "card_number") %>%
  mutate(
    orientation = if_else(reversed == 1, "Reversed", "Upright"),
    meaning     = if_else(reversed == 1, reversed_meaning, upright_meaning)
  )

stopifnot(nrow(draw) == 3, !any(is.na(draw$card_name)))

#Sentiment prediction 
drawn <- str_to_lower(draw$card_name)

hits <- tarot_train %>%
  filter(str_to_lower(card_name_1) %in% drawn |
         str_to_lower(card_name_2) %in% drawn |
         str_to_lower(card_name_3) %in% drawn)

pooled <- c(hits$top_sentiment, hits$second_sentiment, hits$third_sentiment)
pooled <- pooled[!is.na(pooled)]

tally <- sort(table(pooled), decreasing = TRUE)
ranked <- names(tally)
if (length(ranked) < 3) ranked <- c(ranked, setdiff(label_set, ranked))
predicted <- c(top = ranked[1], second = ranked[2], third = ranked[3])

cat("Readings used for prediction:", nrow(hits), "\n")

#Formulate the reading 
spread_txt <- paste0(
  draw$position, ": ", draw$card_name, " (", draw$orientation, "), meaning: ",
  draw$meaning, collapse = "\n"
)

read_system <- paste0(
  "You are a thoughtful tarot reader. Write only the reading itself, as plain prose ",
  "in a single paragraph. Do not use labels, headings, bullet points, notes, drafts, ",
  "or angle brackets. Do not mention sentiments, predictions, or the simulated data."
)

read_user <- paste0(
  "Spread (Past, Present, Future):\n", spread_txt, "\n\n",
  "Tone: the dominant feeling is ", predicted["top"],
  ", with ", predicted["second"], " and ", predicted["third"],
  " also present. Let the dominant feeling set the tone.\n\n",
  "Write about 100 words. Name all three cards (",
  paste(draw$card_name, collapse = ", "), "). ",
  "Connect them in their positions, and use the upright or reversed meaning for each card as given."
)

looks_ok <- function(txt) {
  txt <- str_trim(txt)
  nzchar(txt) &&
    !str_detect(txt, "[<>]|reading text|\\*|Draft|Let's|I will|I must") &&
    str_count(txt, "\\S+") >= 60 &&
    all(str_detect(str_to_lower(txt), fixed(str_to_lower(draw$card_name))))
}

final_reading <- NA_character_
last_reply    <- ""
for (attempt in 1:3) {
  last_reply <- ask_dartmouth(read_user, read_system, temperature = 0.7, max_tokens = 800)
  if (looks_ok(last_reply)) {
    final_reading <- str_trim(last_reply)
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(final_reading)) {
  stop("The model did not return a clean reading after 3 tries. Last reply:\n", last_reply)
}

#Printing the Output
cat("# Tarot Reading\n\n")
cat("**Card numbers:** ", paste(card_numbers, collapse = ", "), "  \n", sep = "")
cat("**Orientation (0 = upright, 1 = reversed):** ",
    paste(reverse_upright, collapse = ", "), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("## Cards Drawn\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(draw))) {
  row <- draw[i, ]
  link <- if (is.na(row$guide_url) || row$guide_url == "") {
    "No guide link available"
  } else {
    paste0("[Learn more](", row$guide_url, ")")
  }
  cat("- **", row$position, ":** ", row$card_name, " (", row$orientation, ") - ",
      link, "\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\n## Reading\n\n")
cat(final_reading, "\n")
```

**AI STATEMENT: The readings are generated by a tarot-specific trained google.gemma-4-31B-it model. Additionally Claude Haiku 5.5 was used to debug the coding workflow and to generate better designed prompt for the tarot-trained local model.**
